useSyncExternalStore subscribes to an external store and reads snapshots in a way compatible with React
rendering.

A component observes a store that publishes connectivity status.
External store changes subscribe callback getSnapshot React render
Read the diagram: React can check the snapshot and keep subscribed components consistent.

Expected result: In a configured app, online reflects the store snapshot; subscribe must return an
unsubscribe function.

Interview question: Why not simply read an external mutable variable during render?
Answer: React would not know when it changes; useSyncExternalStore supplies a subscription
contract.
Practice: Implement a small external counter store.
